---
title: "Research"
aliases:
  - publications.html
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script>
      document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        var b = e.target.closest(".abs-toggle"); if (!b) return;
        var t = b.closest(".paper").querySelector(".abs-text");
        var open = t.hasAttribute("hidden");
        if (open) t.removeAttribute("hidden"); else t.setAttribute("hidden", "");
        b.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
      });
      </script>
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
source("R/pubs.R")
pubs <- yaml::read_yaml("data/publications.yml")
cat("## Working papers\n\n");  paper_section(pubs, "forthcoming")
cat("\n## Publications\n\n### Economics {.subsec}\n\n");  paper_section(pubs, "econ")
cat("\n### Health policy {.subsec}\n\n");  paper_section(pubs, "policy", by_year = TRUE)
```
